senses: A subordinate of the former, who collected taxes or tolls in a particular district, a tax-gatherer
lex:
τελώνης, -ου, ὁ
(τέλος, ὠνέομαι)
__1. a farmer of taxes (Let. publicanus).
__2. A subordinate of the former, who collected taxes or tolls in a particular district, a tax-gatherer (EV, publican): Mat.5:46 10:3, Luk.3:12 5:27, 29 7:29 18:10-11, 13; pl., τ. κ. ἁμαρτωλοί, Mat.9:10-11 11:19, Mrk.2:15-16, Luk.5:30 7:34 15:1; τ. κ. πόρναι, Mat.21:31-32; ὁ ἐθνικὸς κ. ὁ τ., Mat.18:17 (cf. DB, iv, 172; ext., 394 f.; MM, xxiv).†

strongs.def: a tax-farmer, i.e. collector of public revenue
